units.ref_zh: 男孩身上带红色条纹的藏青色连帽衫
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将男孩身上带红色条纹的藏青色连帽衫替换为一件蓝色牛仔夹克。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 将选中区域替换为一件蓝色牛仔夹克。
units.reason: Old mask was the whole boy (54% of image, incl. head and hands); new v2 mask is the hoodie only. Garment is a hoodie, not a shirt; only one child so 'far left' dropped.

spec.ref: the green metal railing on top of the far wall

units.ref_zh: 远处矮墙顶上的绿色金属栏杆
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将远处矮墙顶上的绿色金属栏杆的颜色改为亮黄色。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 将选中区域的颜色改为亮黄色。
units.reason: Old mask was a concrete wall wedge behind the boy's chin, not a sleeve (no second child exists). Retargeted to the clearly visible green railing (SAM3 'green metal railing', viewed final.jpg); kept attribute/colour.

spec.ref: the nearer of the two blue pedestrian-crossing signs beyond the railing
spec.payload: a small red triangular warning sticker

units.ref_zh: 栏杆外两块蓝色人行横道标志中较近的那块
units.instruction_ref_zh: 在栏杆外两块蓝色人行横道标志中较近的那块上加上一张红色三角形小警示贴纸。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 给选中区域加上一张红色三角形小警示贴纸。
units.reason: 'a red symbol' was vague; no crowd in the image; a second, smaller crossing sign stands farther away at x~1265,y~150.
